title: Dream of infiltrating the Order of the Broken Cross apocalyptic cult

tellings.quote: have a dream about the Order of the Broken Cross, which is this apocalyptic cult in Jerusalem.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says he had a dream about getting inside the Order of the Broken Cross, which he calls an apocalyptic cult in Jerusalem. He describes the dream himself on the show, as something he lived through. It comes up in a conversation about whether dreams can show things that are real or that have not happened yet.
